leads.claim: A small sample of charred material from the Socorro scene was collected and retained by the Albuquerque FBI office.
leads.why: The document explicitly states that a physical sample of material was taken and is being held by a government office.
leads.government_response: The material was collected and a statement was taken as part of an investigation.
leads.quote: a small sample of charred material taken at the scene

leads.claim: Indented steel was sent to a metallurgical chemist for analysis regarding the force required to create the indentation.
leads.why: It describes the analysis of physical material but does not explicitly link the material to a UAP/UFO origin.
leads.government_response: The chemist analyzed the force required to produce the indentation.
leads.quote: The indented steel was sent to a metallurgical chemist

leads.claim: The FBI denies having custody of an occupant from a foreign planet.
leads.why: It is a direct government statement regarding the custody of biological material.
leads.quote: the FBI has never had custody of an occupant from a foreign planet

doc_verdict: This document contains a specific reference to the FBI retaining a physical sample of charred material from the Socorro incident, as well as a denial regarding the custody of biological occupants.
